intro: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit is a rite of passage quest marking an initiate's return from communing with the Great Cat Spirit of Zephras. Having absorbed the stealth, speed, and ferocity of the wild cat, the initiate presents their newly awakened aura to Dendrite for further spiritual instruction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.
Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.
May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.

I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.
Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.
